items.label: Structural Integrity
items.text: Warranty against structural failure of frames, profiles, and welded joints (e.g., 10 years).

items.label: Insulated Glass Units (IGUs / Double Glazing)
items.text: Coverage against internal seal failure, condensation between panes, or premature delamination (e.g., 5 to 10 years).

items.label: Hardware & Mechanisms
items.text: Warranty for handles, hinges, sliding tracks, and locking mechanisms against mechanical defects (e.g., 2 to 5 years).

items.label: Finishes & Coatings
items.text: Coverage for powder coating, anodizing, or specialized surface treatments against peeling, cracking, or severe fading under normal environmental exposure (e.g., 5 years).

items.label: Improper Installation
items.text: Damage resulting from installation performed by unauthorized third parties or failure to follow engineering guidelines.

items.label: Site Conditions & Structural Movement
items.text: Issues caused by building settlement, structural shifts, or sub-base movements of the civil works.

items.label: Lack of Maintenance
items.text: Damage resulting from the absence of regular cleaning, lack of lubrication on hardware, or exposure to harsh unapproved chemical cleaners.

items.label: Accidents & External Forces
items.text: Damage caused by extreme weather events exceeding design limits (hurricanes, floods), vandalism, abuse, or unauthorized modifications.

items.label: Normal Wear and Tear
items.text: Minor cosmetic weathering, scratches, or natural patina changes on moving parts over extended use.
